description: AERPAW at North Carolina State University publishes this experimental collection. The 15 September 2023 experiment records Ericsson 5G non-standalone network radio and throughput measurements from a UAV at approximately 30 metres following a zigzag trajectory. The source identifies Centennial Campus and Lake Wheeler deployments with C-band equipment and 120-degree antennas. Variables include LTE/NR received power, signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio, channel quality, modulation and coding, and throughput. These observations support wireless performance benchmarking and network planning. Coverage is limited to the described experimental campaign. The linked Dryad release is registered under CC0 1.0 and is publicly accessible without charge. Formats and variables are described by the provider; the files were not downloaded. Caveats include campaign-specific equipment and conditions, which limit transfer to other networks. Simulation use: 5G aerial-network performance and capacity planning. Related records include the NSF PAWR testbed platform, which describes the wider experimental infrastructure.
